the remaining rows are updated on the GPU\nconstexpr size_t CPU_ROW_PERCENT = 10;\nconstexpr unsigned int GPU_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                  \\\n    do {                                                                                  \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                        \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                        \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,              \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                 \\\n        }                                                                                 \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Fills the path rows firstRow .. firstRow+numRows-1 (same values as the full-matrix initialization:\n// every entry of row i holds i)\nvoid initializePathRows(unsigned int* path, const size_t firstRow, const size_t numRows, const size_t numNodes) {\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < numRows; ++r) {\n        std::fill(path + r * numNodes, path + (r + 1) * numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(firstRow + r));\n    }\n}\n\n// Applies intermediate node k to one local source row (in-place, branch-free form of the\n// \"if (newDist < distIJ)\" update so the inner loop vectorizes)\ninline void relaxRow(unsigned int* distRow, unsigned int* pathRow, const unsigned int* pivotRow,\n                     const size_t numNodes, const unsigned int k) noexcept {\n    const unsigned int distIK = distRow[k];\n    #pragma omp simd\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n        const unsigned int distIJ = distRow[j];\n        const unsigned int newDist = distIK + pivotRow[j];\n        const bool improved = newDist < distIJ;\n        distRow[j] = improved ? newDist : distIJ;\n        pathRow[j] = improved ? k : pathRow[j];\n    }\n}\n\n// Applies intermediate node k to the GPU-resident rows of this rank\n__global__ void floydWarshallStepGpu(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                                     const unsigned int* __restrict__ pivotRow,\n                                     const size_t numRows, const size_t numNodes, const unsigned int k) {\n    const size_t j = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (j >= numNodes) {\n        return;\n    }\n    for (size_t i = blockIdx.y; i < numRows; i += gridDim.y) {\n        unsigned int* distRow = dist + i * numNodes;\n        unsigned int* pathRow = path + i * numNodes;\n        const unsigned int newDist = distRow[k] + pivotRow[j];\n        if (newDist < distRow[j]) {\n            distRow[j] = newDist;\n            pathRow[j] = k;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Row-block partition of the distance matrix across MPI ranks\nstruct RowPartition {\n    std::vector<int> counts;  // rows owned by each rank\n    std::vector<int> starts;  // first global row owned by each rank\n\n    int owner(const size_t row) const {\n        int r = 0;\n        while (static_cast<size_t>(starts[r] + counts[r]) <= row) {\n            ++r;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n};\n\n// Floyd-Warshall over the distributed matrix. \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, \n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n    \n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;\n            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;\n        }\n        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // For each source node i\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n                \n                if (newDist < distIJ) {\n                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;\n                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;\n                }\n Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg11ywbYaybhP54Pxeff2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark now runs as a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program. All hashes and full output match the original at every rank count I tried, and the build is clean with no warnings. The only files changed are `floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp` and `floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt`; the executable name is unchanged and no new files were created in the repo.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI:** rows are split into contiguous blocks, one block per rank. Each step `k`, the rank owning row `k` broadcasts it, and every rank relaxes its own rows. Rank 0 generates the matrix with the original RNG sequence, scatters it, and gathers it back only when `-r` or `-v` needs it.\n- **CUDA:** each rank drives one GPU (round-robin over the node's devices). Its first 90% of rows live on the GPU, and a kernel applies step `k` to them.\n- **OpenMP:** the remaining 10% of each rank's rows are updated by host threads while the GPU kernel runs. Each rank gets an equal share of the node's cores. OpenMP also parallelizes path initialization.\n- **Semantics:** the in-place update is safe within a step because row `k` and column `k` don't change at that step. The path matrix is still maintained, though it isn't printed.\n\n**CMake**\n- `project` now enables CUDA, and `floydwarshall.cpp` is compiled as CUDA via `LANGUAGE CUDA`, so there is no separate `.cu` file.\n- MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA runtime are linked unconditionally.\n- The minimum CMake version went from 3.10 to 3.24, which the `native`-free architecture list and CUDA setup need.\n- The default CUDA architectures are `75 80 86 89 90`. Override with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=...` if needed.\n\n**Verification**\n- Hashes match the original for n = 512, 1000, 37, 300 (full output identical), and for n = 0, 1, 3 at 1–4 ranks.\n- The path matrix matches the original's, checked in scratch copies under `/tmp` for n = 100 and 257 at 1, 3, and 4 ranks.\n- `-h` and unknown options behave as before.\n- Timing at n = 2048: original 9391 ms, hybrid 303 / 151 / 104 ms on 1 / 2 / 4 ranks. At n = 4096 with 4 ranks: 305 ms.\n\n**Caveats**\n- I tested on one node with four RTX 3090s only, not on a multi-node cluster.\n- The 10% CPU share is an untuned starting point. Tune `CPU_ROW_PERCENT` for your hardware.\n- Each step's pivot broadcast is synchronous. Overlapping it with the next step's compute would be the next performance win, but I left that out to keep the change verifiable.\n- The timed speedup is mostly GPU versus the original's single core, not a measure of the parallel scaling itself."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":718,"cache_read_input_tokens":70207,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":718},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"68c036c9-9ace-4d56-823f-897729d21367","uuid":"bfb513ff-1417-45c7-b891-fb24ff55bd05","timestamp":"2026-10-13T22:22:51.971Z","request_id":"req_011Cg11ywETvTkRoLt2QR8e5"}
